title: City Council Regular Meeting
motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Smethurst to approve the Conditional Use Permit (CUP) to operate a bar establishment in the arts district overlay zone located at 2 West St. George Blvd #5 under the provisions that the ordinance return to change the number of bars allowed in the area. City Attorney Shawn Guzman noted this is in the Arts District and currently allows for four (4) bar establishments. If the Council wishes to change the number allowed, the four (4) approved would grandfathered in. The Arts District is a very small area. He asked that Councilmember Smethurst separate the motion – a conditional use permit and then directing staff to bring the ordinance back for amendments and provide staff with a number they would like to allow.
result: 3-1 Pass (The motion carried.)
